referenceDna.annotatedDescription: The direct The Six Bells Inn website in Rosendale, New York uses storybook exterior beneath a small forest-green booking ribbon. Navigation is quiet lodge navigation with room and table routes. Its page moves through storybook opening, inn introduction, room gallery, restaurant and events, press quotations, shop feature, newsletter and contact, with named guest rooms shown as illustrated or photographic invitations. cozy interiors in small framed gallery windows. Transferable mechanics are storybook border, room portrait grid, inn-and-table routes. The brand identity, people, photographs, reviews, wording and business claims remain source-only.
